_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored — keep hostnames, usernames and anything else identifying out of version control.
_machines: One entry per machine you want counted. ccusage only ever sees the logs on
the machine it runs on, so each machine must be collected separately.
Exactly one entry omits 'ssh' — that's the machine you run this script on.
Every other entry is driven over SSH and needs working key-based auth.
'id' is used for the raw filename (raw/ccusage-<id>-rolling.json), so
changing it starts a fresh snapshot. 'label' is what the report displays.
'remoteShell' wraps the remote command so login-shell PATH is applied —
needed when node/npx come from Homebrew or a version manager.
Optional claudeConfigDirs and codexHomes list absolute profile roots
to collect. Every listed root must have projects/ or sessions/ respectively.
Use distinct roots for separate profiles; a shared Codex home cannot
identify which signed-in account created an old session.
_archiveMonthly: Default true. The rolling window is rebuilt from local agent logs every
run, so it is only ever as deep as those logs — and agents prune old
sessions on their own retention timers, at different depths per agent.
With this on, the first run of each month freezes the previous month to
raw/ccusage-<id>-<first>_<last>.json, written once and never overwritten,
so your history survives the pruning. Backfill older months while their
_expectedAccounts: Optional: add expectedAccounts with claude/codex counts after listing
explicit profile roots on every machine. The report then compares checked
log roots with expected accounts, while noting shared Codex sign-ins
cannot be attributed to individual accounts.
_publishCommand: Optional. This project only generates HTML into reports/ — publishing it
anywhere is your business, not the repo's. Leave null to just write files.
